records.text: Gloria Steinem was sponsored by the CIA.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Gloria Steinem was sponsored by the CIA,

verification.notes: Archived contemporaneous reporting and later declassified material document that the Independent Research Service led by Steinem received major CIA funding from 1958 to 1962. In the ordinary funding sense of 'sponsored,' the statement is supported, though it should not be expanded into a claim that the CIA created feminism.

sources.title: CIA Reading Room: Washington Post report on Gloria Steinem and CIA funds
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous report preserved in the CIA Reading Room documenting CIA funding for Steinem's organization.
